original_card.question: Does one quantified step of the proposed #4100 all-size construction hold at its actual caller?
methods: Prove one missing implication with explicit quantified hypotheses.
Find an exact counterexample at the claimed interface boundary.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

first_step.inspect: Read PROOF.md and AUDIT.md in #4100. Select one distinct obligation: CRT total repair, native/free-algebra lifting, precision/conditioning, or complete fixed-tape cost. This is an author-submitted proof, not an accepted unconditional theorem.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

original_card.first_experiment: Check live handoffs; name one proposition, its caller, quantified domain and dependency closure. Independently prove the implication or exhibit a precise gap/counterexample. Prioritize CRT.md total repair or COMPLEX.md free-algebra lift only if unclaimed. Stop at the chosen obligation; do not substitute finite samples or root arithmetic for an all-size proof, or launch the complete package by default.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Finite supplier improvements are useful only under the retained transfer obligations.
allowed_variations: One CRT repair, native lift, precision/conditioning or tape-cost proposition, with its exact caller.
scope_change_triggers: Replacing a quantified obligation with another finite smoke test.
Treating archive intake, an author PASS receipt or a finite composed fixture as discharge of the universal hypotheses.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4100: proposed unconditional construction and finite checks, without independent acceptance.
existing_checks.remaining: Independent proof audit of one caller-bound all-size implication; all other premises remain explicit.

actual_scope: Prove, for every root width h>=1, that COMPLEX.md's stopped complex recursion (children r*floor(e/73) with the PR4088 mixed histogram over W=322560, stop width max(73,h^eta), node cost O(V e^(1-a2) polylog p), elementary remainders and leaves, root placement) costs at most V Lambda h^(1-q) [(c_N+c_L)/(1-mu_tau)+73^b c_L+2c_P], with certified mu_tau<1 and mu_(1-b)<=1, and bind it to PROOF.md's synthetic-transform layers and GAUSSIAN.md's compiled layers. The node-cost, child-volume and leaf premises stay explicit.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one quantified #4100 implication at its actual caller. This package takes the native/complex-family obligation that docs/research/pr4100-audit-coverage-map.md lists as open after #4178: COMPLEX.md's stopped-recursion time bill, at the PR4088 mixed histogram and the PROOF.md and GAUSSIAN.md layer callers. It avoids CRT.md and the precision chain (#4371, #4415, #4178).
bottleneck_link: Side result for the #4100 audit: it closes one transfer implication, the stopped complex moment, under COMPLEX.md's own node premises. It does not change any kappa or the selected frontier.
stop_rule: Stop after the all-size lemma and theorem, the certified moment enclosures, three rejection controls and bounded tree corroboration. Do not audit the node-cost premise, the free-word lift, CRT.md or the precision chain.
evidence: PROOF.md: written strong induction over all widths, with floors, remainders and an arbitrary stop width s>=73. verify.py: exact exponent order, certified rational enclosures of mu_tau and mu_(1-b), rejection controls, and 60-digit numerical tree corroboration. The tree check is corroboration, not a certificate.

open_questions.question: Is COMPLEX.md's node-cost premise true at the actual node: adapters, F2 row-addition monomials through the compact primitive, the Gamma-fold common-cover packet gathers and parking all cost O(V e^(1-a2) polylog p), uniformly in e?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The theorem here is conditional on it. Whether the per-cover-value gathers scan only the cover's own rows or the whole node volume changes only a constant, but a per-node term not bounded by V e^(1-a2) polylog p would break the bill.
open_questions.first_step: Write a per-node invoice from COMPLEX.md's 'Common cover, fresh rows and fixed tapes' section and PR2250 sections 5-6, with the row-field layout of #4424.
open_questions.blocked_by: A literal node-level tape layout for the Gamma cover field is not written in #4100.

open_questions.question: Do the actual child packets realize the moment's volume normalization: Gamma*H_r rank-r child calls of volume V/(W Gamma) each, at width r*floor(e/73)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: mu_x uses H_r/W as the total child volume per unit parent volume. #4375 shows that the factorwise reading breaks the moment, so this premise carries the whole stopped bill.
open_questions.first_step: Bind PR4088's owner fill (3240*408 roles) and the W-family split to per-child packet volumes on one cover value.
